prompt:
Create production animation sprite atlas of THESE EXACT wooden double gates from reference, for Last Bastion. Match reference identity faithfully: dusty mauve chunky stone sideposts and sparse rubble at their feet, deep burgundy vertical wooden boards with ragged lower ends, heavy top rail, horizontal reinforcing rail with three small bone diamond rivets on each leaf, blunt square wood crenellations. NO arch, portcullis, roof, flags, symbols, scenery, text or gridlines. Angular gothic grotesque coarse pixel illustration, black contours, 3-4 discrete shades, bone dusty lilac wine charcoal, no glow gradients blur or realistic materials.
EXACT4columns x2rows =EIGHT chronological opening frames left to right then next row. Requested canvas2048x768, cell512x384. Each cell SAME fixed camera, scale, stoneposts, ground anchor and framing with10%transparent margin. Genuine transparent alpha0 outside artwork AND in opening between leaves, NO background, no groundplate, no castshadow.
Two gate leaves attached by hinges to stationary far LEFT and RIGHT stoneposts. Stoneposts stand exactly same coordinates ALL8FRAMES and samewidth. Doors ROTATE about their outer vertical hinge edges, their width and details in 3D stay same, only perspective foreshortening changes; NEVER slide sideways or shrink vertically. Seen from elevated frontal camera south of wall looking north into fortress. Leaves swing INWARD away from viewer toward top of image. Frame1 COMPLETELY CLOSED, two equal wood leaves meet at center with narrow seam, block passage. Frame2 opening10degrees, frame3 25degrees, frame4 40degrees, frame5 55degrees, frame6 70degrees, frame7 82degrees, frame8 FULLY OPEN90degrees: doors nearly edge-on, along sides of passage pointing back north; central doorway completely clear and transparent. Both rotate symmetrically. No new objects appear. Stoneposts and rubble MUST NOT move or change betweenframes. IMPORTANT firstframe is CLOSED, finalframe OPEN, not all frames same partially open reference. Keep each full gate structure within its own cell with consistent groundbaseline at85%cellheight. The reference image provides design, its current open angle is NOT frame1.
